subject.title: fix(googlechat): media downloads can grow unbounded without a size cap

question: Should the Google Chat media helper fail closed at the documented 20 MiB default when direct callers omit `maxBytes`?
rationale: The patch fixes a real unbounded response-buffering path, but it changes exported helper behavior for omitted caps, so maintainers should intentionally accept the compatibility tradeoff before merge.

options.title: Accept the 20 MiB helper default
options.body: Land this patch with the documented Google Chat media default and require direct callers needing larger media to pass an explicit `maxBytes`.

options.title: Pause for a different API contract
options.body: Hold the PR if omitted `maxBytes` should retain a different public meaning, then document and test that contract first.

recommendation.title: Accept the 20 MiB helper default
recommendation.body: Land this patch with the documented Google Chat media default and require direct callers needing larger media to pass an explicit `maxBytes`.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the cap-alignment commit and already framed the remaining action as serialized maintainer landing.
